props.name: items
props.description: The links, in order of priority — the last ones move into More first.

props.name: currentId
props.description: Id of the current page. Kept in the bar whenever it fits, and marked `aria-current="page"` wherever it is.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

props.name: linkAs
props.description: Component that renders each link — a router `Link`. It receives `href`, or `to` when `linkProp` is `to`.

props.name: linkProp
props.description: Which prop carries the destination on `linkAs`.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called when any link is followed, from the bar or from More.
